title: 航空宇宙文献調査入門
subtitle: Introduction to Aerospace Literature Survey
teachers:
HIROMITSU Nagayoshi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)	learn how to prepare an engineering report.
(2)	learn how to search engineering documents.
(3)	consider the future major subject they will study in PD III.
(4)	learn to express their ideas through engineering reports.
advice:
This is a basic engineering report preparation skills course. We will cover the following:
1.	Problem discovery
2.	Intelligence, analysis and rearranging
3.	Problem solving
4.	Engineering report preparation
5.	Distinguishing plagiarism and quotation
Students are required to understand technological trends in the aerospace field.
Students are requested to discover problems in the field of the aeronautical engineering and examine them intellectually through analysis and rearranging.
Students are expected to learn the method of expression and the correct report format for the field of aeronautical engineering and how to prepare a paper.
requiredKnowledge:
Advanced reading and writing abilities on personal events.
Be familiar with the usage of the Internet and the Library Center.

activityGoals.body: Be able to discover problems in the field of aerospace engineering and set the theme of a report.
Be able to collect, analyze, and arrange information in the field of aerospace engineering.
Be able to create a report which meets the requirements of the field of aerospace engineering.

lessons.content:
Information gathering
